read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, value profiles and capability declaration
input: MESH-equivalent maximum hail diameter (mm; inches are converted), 0 to 100 mm (clamp or warn)
not_covered: Tracker steel (used only as a stow conditioner; direct damage has no curve)
SCADA and met instruments (optional secondary; no curve)
Inverters, substation, foundations, civil works and drainage (treated as no direct hail damage by coverage decision; no curve)
out_of_scope: Yearly and tail loss metrics (computed by the consumer, not the cell)
Site value and exposure basis (supplied by the consumer)
missing_mechanisms: Cell cracking or latent performance loss without glass breakage
Wind-driven hail hitting the module face (open seam, not in the diameter-only curve)

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the PV modules; the plant share comes from a named value profile (direct module hardware, or the Hazard-compatible adapter) or a site value basis, with no default

outputs.single_event: allowed: module damage ratio (missing module type uses the default curve with a flag)
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: needs a named value profile or site value basis and an exposure fraction
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: computed by the consumer from a frequency-driven loss simulation with caps applied and known-answer tests passing; curve spread not carried

conditions: Exactly one module type must match; a missing type uses the default with DEFAULT_SELECTOR_USED, an unknown type is rejected
Hail size unit must be stated; inches are converted to mm
Stow probability is the event-time stow state, not hail frequency; stow results carry the placeholder flag
A value profile must be named; none is applied implicitly

method.summary: Logistic curves per module type fitted to public PVEL/Kiwa hail-test breakage anchors and the IEC baseline; glass-breakage probability used as the module replacement ratio

key_sources: Kiwa PVEL, Hail Stress Sequence scorecard (KIWA_PVEL_HSS)
DOE/FEMP, Hail Damage Mitigation for Solar PV Systems (DOE_FEMP_HAIL_GUIDANCE)
judgment: Tracker stow shifts the curve by +8 mm (direction supported, size not calibrated)
Hazard-compatible value profile assigns all general replacement fieldwork to the modules

checks.name: Financial range check (Hazard repo): industry loss figures for solar hail

open_items: Recalibrate if claims show replacement policy differs from glass-breakage probability
Wind-driven hail contact effect needs event wind and tracker orientation data
Stow adjustment awaits tracker stow-angle impact testing
Notebook walkthrough source paths are not repository-current

rows.variants: module type: fragile thin glass-glass / default 3.2 mm glass-backsheet / hail-hardened thicker glass; optional tracker stow blend
rows.shape_basis: D50 and slope fitted to public lab anchors (fragile and default T2; hardened variant T3)
rows.cost_basis: Direct module-hardware value share from the NLR Q1-2025 basis (T2); optional Hazard-adapter profile is T4

notes.text: Glass-breakage probability is used as the module replacement ratio
Stow adjustment applies only when a stow state is supplied (T4 placeholder)
